visual_review: Exactly six dark muzzle interiors retained in the same cluster, original front support ring and apertures, carry handle, grip and lower drum. Pale pearl-ivory finish with faint pink traces only at old red panels; no saturated red, dark patina, muzzle light or external glow. Receiver scroll panel and replacement barrel band retained, one thin internal lit line. Unchanged prompt succeeded after prior rejection; native and earlier error preserved.
